name: How long does sewer line locating take?

mainEntity.name: How long does sewer line locating take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to locate a sewer line typically depends on the length and complexity of your property's sewer system, as well as the ease of access to the cleanout. For a standard residential property, the process can often be completed within one to two hours. However, more extensive systems or properties with limited access might require additional time. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC prioritizes efficient service to minimize disruption to your day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer line locating typically takes 1-2 hours for standard residential properties, though it can vary based on system complexity and access.
